fields.subject: ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable
fields.response: return false when the failure is a concurrency conflict: a SqlException carrying error number 51000 (raised by wtr.OrleansClusterInsertMemberKeyV2 when the stored table etag does not equal the TableVersion etag or a row for the silo already exists) or an In-Memory OLTP write-conflict error 41302, 41305, 41325 or 41301; otherwise log the exception and propagate it to the caller
fields.postcondition: InsertRow returns true when the insert completes, having advanced the table etag by one and stamped the new etag on the inserted row; false for an etag/version conflict or an already-existing silo row, with nothing changed; and never converts a connection, timeout, or other non-conflict failure into a false result
